name: MaGS Pipeline
definition: A pipeline for reconstructing and simulating dynamic 3D objects by optimizing mesh-adsorbed Gaussians, involving mesh refinement and Gaussian optimization from input video frames and an initial mesh.
summary: The MaGS Pipeline reconstructs dynamic 3D objects by optimizing mesh-adsorbed Gaussians anchored to a deformable mesh, ensuring consistent topology for high-fidelity rendering and simulation.
